productArea.name: Pull requests
productArea.scope: Search, filter, create, and manage pull requests across global, organization, and repository lists, including branch selection, reviews, discussion, inline comments, commit and file tabs, branch updates, merging, closing, reopening, and defaults. Actions, branch protection policies, and management of labels, milestones, or projects linked from a pull request are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Pull Requests in the global navigation and use its search and filters.
Choose Pull Requests in the seeded repository and open a request for its conversation, commits, files, reviews, and merge controls. If the list is empty, create a pull request through Compare first.

If no changed head branch exists, create a disposable branch from main and commit a file change through Code as a prerequisite. Choose New Pull Request or Compare and compare that branch against main to create a request.
Choose Settings then Units Overview and inspect only the pull request defaults and enablement controls.
Open an organization you can access, then its Pull Requests dashboard and team filters. Create a disposable organization if none exists.
